Request for Muze Entertainment: Please release a standard-sized CD of "Runaway" with more songs. I want to buy 2 copies of such a CD. Don't just have "digital" CDs. Also, we prefer standard sized (large) CDs because we can play those in our cars. The mini-CDs do not play in car CD players, which are usually slot players and mini-CDs can only play in CD players that have a flat tray.
